silicon_melting_2.name: Melting of Silicon - Level 2
silicon_melting_2.description: Simulate the melting of Silicon by heating under NPT conditions using the Stillinger–Weber (SW) potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Compute the mean squared displacement (MSD) of Si atoms over the trajectory. Identify the melting point as the first frame where the MSD shows a sudden jump. Compute the diffusion constant (self-diffusivity) in the molten state using the MSD after the detected melting point, and report the average value in m²/s.
